text:
alyssa: Heads-up team — Helios customer story is moving fast. Need final quote approval, logo release, and webinar teaser. Planning publish Thu AM PST (embargo until then).

todd: Great. When is the interview?

alyssa: Wed 11:00 CET (their morning). Blocking 20 min. Todd, can you cover customer ops; Sanjay for perf details.

sanjay: Yep. I'll bring p95 numbers and token-cost delta. Quick reminder: we should avoid publishing internal thresholds without explicit consent.

alyssa: Agreed. We'll capture numbers during call and ask Helios to sign the quote after we draft it.

emma: PR needs 24h to prep assets. Also want a 1-liner quote for the webinar slide and a ~280-char social blurb.

remy: Helios (remy): Wed 11 CET works. We'll have VP of ML and our customer success lead. They can share metrics if cleared.

legal: To speed sign-off: please use our quote template and request explicit "permission to publish" in the follow-up. Our normal review is 48 hrs but we can do 24 if marked high priority.

alyssa: Draft quote I plan to use (will paste in follow-up and invite):

```
"Since moving to Redwood, our batch inference latency dropped ~2.8x and per-call compute cost decreased by ~37% — enabling faster iterations and lower ops spend."
```

alyssa: Legal, any issues with that phrasing?

legal: That phrasing is fine if Helios confirms the numbers are OK to publish. If they prefer ranges or anonymized numbers we can adjust. Also need a signed logo release form for any brand assets.

emma: I'll prepare slide template + social drafts and attach to the follow-up email. Can someone confirm the quote length for slide? Prefer <=22 words.

todd: I'll ask Helios to provide a short teaser during the call — something like "Redwood cut our latency and let us ship features faster."

remy: remy: we'll try to get a short on-airable line.

alyssa: Checklist for publish: 1) Signed quote (customer email ok) 2) Logo release form signed 3) Legal sign-off on final text 4) PR assets ready 5) Customer confirms embargo Thu AM PST.

devops-bot: Reminder: record the meeting if participants consent. Meeting recordings stored in Drive/Meetings/Helios-YYYYMMDD.

remy: remy: Recording is fine. We'll approve transcript and quote via email after the call.

sanjay: After we get numbers, can we also ask permission to publish a small performance table? e.g., p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens. If they say no, we can use percentages only.

legal: Good call. Add that to the approval ask. Also provide source-of-truth backup (internal report or screenshot) if we reference exact numbers.

alyssa: After call I'll send a follow-up with: draft quote (for sign-off), logo release link, proposed publish date/time, and a short appendix with the numbers referenced. Legal will review once they return signed email.

emma: If everything clears, PR will queue publish Thu 9am PST. I'll send a final asset pack to the Helios comms contact for opt-in.

todd: FYI: I'll request a short bio + headshot from the Helios speaker for the post.

alyssa: Perfect. Anything else?

remy: remy: We'll aim to sign the quote within 24h after the call.

alyssa: Thanks all 680. I'll update this thread with the signed files and final copy once I have them.

legal: Keep us looped if they want edits to the quote text; we can usually clear minor wording quickly.

emma: I'll start drafting the social copy now and post a preview later today. 

alyssa: Closing checklist pinned: invite set  quote draft in invite notes  logo request sent  legal looped  PR draft queued. Will report back after the call.
